summary: Tested B35 Community Knowledge, Project Sharing & Moderation Engine end-to-end. Backend: 19/19 pytest cases pass (test_b35_community_iter75.py) covering /api/hi/community/categories, POST /content pre-checks (clean=no flags/safe; PII phone + 'bypass the breaker' in Electrical Safety => flags include personal_information + unsafe_high_risk, safety_classification 'high_risk', requires_enhanced_review True), POST /content/{id}/submit (high-risk => 'reviewing', clean => 'submitted', private visibility rejected 400), GET /content/mine, PUT + DELETE (archive), admin dashboard (by_status/queue_size/open_reports), admin queue includes submitted+reviewing items, POST /content/{id}/decision approve => 'approved' + appears in /feed, request_changes => 'draft'. Vote helpful is idempotent per user and recomputes helpful_count. Save/unsave/GET /saved work. Report content persists. Comments auto-approve on approved non-high-risk content; blocked with 409 on high-risk category (Electrical Safety) when comments_in_high_risk_enabled=false. draft-assist returns sensitive_info_found list and includes deterministic PII flag. Admin GET /reports, GET+PUT /settings (toggle round-trips), and GET /audit (moderation decisions logged) all pass. Regression: /api/hi/admin/voice/dashboard still returns 200. User FRONTEND (390x844 mobile, demo_home@diyhomie.com): /home-intel entry tile testID hi-community-hub is present and navigates to /home-intel/community-hub. Discover feed renders category chips (ch-cat-all, ch-cat-Repairs, ch-cat-Painting, ch-cat-Electrical Safety …), COMMUNITY EXPERIENCE label + community-experiences-supplement disclaimer visible, seed items (incl. tests-created TEST_lesson) show. ch-tab-mine and ch-contribute buttons present. Contribute screen (/home-intel/community-hub/contribute) exposes ch-raw-notes, ch-assist, ch-title, ch-body, ch-submit, ch-type-*, ch-cat-*, ch-vis-anonymous_community/attributed_community/unlisted_share. Content detail (/home-intel/community-hub/<id>) shows COMMUNITY EXPERIENCE + 'Not a substitute for professional advice' disclaimer; cd-helpful (turns 'Helpful' active), cd-save (turns 'Saved' active), cd-report (opens reason chips cd-reason-spam etc.), cd-comment-input + cd-comment-send all working. Admin FRONTEND (1280x900 desktop, Diyhomieapp@gmail.com): admin-nav-voice content now RENDERS FULLY — voice-toggle-input/output/avatar/highrisk, voice-limit-input, voice-limit-save all present (previous iteration_74 blank-module bug is fixed). admin-nav-datagovernance regression content still renders. HOWEVER admin-nav-communityhub IS MISSING FROM THE ADMIN SIDEBAR — enumeration of every [data-testid^='admin-nav-'] element on /admin returned 46 tiles but NONE is 'admin-nav-communityhub'. Root cause: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx declares the 'communityhub' variant in the Mod union (line 52) and renders <CommunityModule/> when mod === 'communityhub' (line 176), and imports CommunityModule at line 50, but the MODULES array (lines 54-100) that drives the sidebar never includes an entry with key: 'communityhub'. Because there is no tile, the module is unreachable from the UI — cm-tab-queue/reports/settings, cm-approve-*, cm-reject-*, cm-toggle-pause, cm-toggle-comments are all absent from the DOM. Backend for the module is 100% healthy (queued/approved via pytest against /api/hi/admin/community/*).

rca_of_issue: Symptom: On /admin the sidebar has 46 admin-nav-* tiles but no 'admin-nav-communityhub'. Repro: login as admin, /admin, enumerate document.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="admin-nav-"]'). Cause: /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx imports CommunityModule (line 50), extends the Mod union with 'communityhub' (line 52) and renders it (line 176 {mod === 'communityhub' && <CommunityModule />}), but the sidebar-driving MODULES array (lines 54–100) never includes the key. Because the sidebar iterates MODULES.map to emit testID admin-nav-${key}, no tile is emitted, so the module is unreachable in the UI even though wiring is otherwise complete. Fix: add { key: 'communityhub', label: 'Community', icon: 'account-group-outline' } to MODULES (a natural place is right after the 'voice' entry). No backend or CommunityModule changes needed.
